title: UNIT 1: SUB-FIELDS OF BIOLOGY
notes: ✓ Biology is the scientific study of living organisms. It is divided into specialized sub-fields that study different organisms, structures, functions and processes.

title: 1.1 SUB-FIELDS OF BIOLOGY
notes:
◆ Morphology → external form and structure
◆ Anatomy → internal structure
◆ Histology → tissues
◆ Cytology → cells
◆ Molecular Biology → DNA, RNA and molecular processes
◆ Physiology → functions of organisms
◆ Embryology → embryo development
◆ Ecology → organisms and their environment
◆ Taxonomy → identification, naming and classification
◆ Paleontology → past organisms and fossils
◆ Genetics → heredity and variation
◆ Evolution → changes in organisms over generations
◆ Exobiology → life in the Universe

title: PURE vs APPLIED BIOLOGY
notes:
→ Pure Biology → develops knowledge about living organisms and biological processes.

→ Applied Biology → uses biological knowledge to solve practical problems.

✓ Examples: Agriculture, Biotechnology, Medicine, Pharmacology, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Horticulture and Fisheries.

title: 1.3 MAJOR DISCOVERIES THAT REVOLUTIONIZED BIOLOGY
notes:
◆ Aristotle → early classification of organisms
◆ Galen → anatomy and medical science
◆ Leeuwenhoek → microorganisms using improved microscopes
◆ Linnaeus → binomial nomenclature and systematic classification
◆ Darwin → evolution by natural selection
◆ Mendel → laws of inheritance
◆ Pasteur → microbiology, fermentation, pasteurization and vaccines
◆ Koch → disease-causing bacteria and bacteriology
◆ Jane Goodall → chimpanzee behavior
◆ Barbara McClintock → transposable genes ('jumping genes')
◆ Watson & Crick → DNA structure
◆ Wilmut & Campbell → cloning of Dolly the sheep

title: MAJOR MEDICAL DISCOVERIES
notes:
◆ Circulatory system → William Harvey
◆ Vaccination → Edward Jenner
◆ Cell theory → Schleiden & Schwann
◆ Germ theory → Robert Koch
◆ X-rays → Wilhelm Röntgen
◆ Vitamins → Frederick Hopkins
◆ Insulin → Frederick Banting
◆ Penicillin → Alexander Fleming
◆ DNA → Friedrich Miescher
◆ Anesthetics → early work by Freud, Koller and Niemann
◆ HIV → Robert Gallo & Luc Montagnier

title: 1.4 CONTRIBUTIONS TO SOCIETY & ENVIRONMENT
notes:
✓ Biological discoveries improve medicine, disease prevention, diagnosis, genetics, environmental studies and forensic science.

◆ Microscopes → study cells and microorganisms
◆ Genetics → understanding heredity and biological variation
◆ Forensics → analysis of biological evidence
◆ Ecology → understanding organisms and ecosystems

title: 1.5 ETHIOPIAN BIOLOGISTS
notes:
◆ Yalemtsehay Mekonnen → research on medicinal plants and their health effects.

◆ Aklilu Lemma → discovered the effectiveness of Endod against freshwater snails that transmit schistosomiasis.

◆ Gebisa Ejeta → developed improved sorghum varieties resistant to Striga and adapted to drought, improving productivity and food security.
